question: Which of the following countries shares the longest land border with India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India shares its **longest land border** with **Bangladesh**, which stretches approximately **4,096 kilometers**.
 
• This border is known as the **India-Bangladesh International Border** and runs through five Indian states: **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram**.
 
• The border was established in **1947** during the partition of I
